problem: The live companion soak should attribute plugin child PID/RSS/CPU and detect PID churn without inventing a second process authority. Re-audit of the pinned N.E.K.O c3 contract found that the assumed host PID read surface is not actually exposed.

reuse_order.reason: The host owns plugin liveness. However, c3's HTTP /plugin/status exposes status records but not the PluginHost HealthCheckResponse pid; HealthCheckResponse has pid internally, while the frontend getPluginHealth() declaration has no matching backend /plugin/{id}/health route.

reuse_order.result: origin/main is still c3fc33ff0d32e4a79fd905d1add22d45725071f5; the missing host-PID read surface is unchanged.

reuse_order.layer: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / PluginStore / native lifecycle
reuse_order.result: Plugin SDK does not expose host process identity or lifecycle-management PID. Plugin self-reporting cannot replace host-owned liveness/PID authority.

reuse_order.asset: optional psutil already used by companion_runtime_soak.py
reuse_order.result: psutil remains suitable only after a trusted host PID is supplied. Process-tree or command-line discovery would create a second attribution authority and is rejected.
OS supervisors/exporters can observe processes but cannot authoritatively map N.E.K.O plugin identity/lifecycle intent, so they do not close this gap.
blocked: there is currently no supported native PID surface to join to psutil without guessing process identity.
reject adding an eleventh N.E.K.O patch, private health endpoint, process scanner, daemon, watchdog, state store or lifecycle router solely for metrics.

verified_native_surfaces.plugin_summary: GET http://127.0.0.1:48916/plugins?summary=true exposes runtime flags and derived running/stopped status, not pid.
verified_native_surfaces.plugin_status: GET http://127.0.0.1:48916/plugin/status exposes PluginStatusManager records, not guaranteed host pid.
verified_native_surfaces.internal_health: plugin/core/host.py HealthCheckResponse contains pid/exitcode/status but c3 has no backend GET /plugin/{plugin_id}/health route exposing it.
verified_native_surfaces.frontend_mismatch: frontend/plugin-manager/src/api/plugins.ts still declares getPluginHealth('/plugin/{id}/health'), but plugin/server/routes/plugins.py does not mount that route.

policy: PID must come from N.E.K.O native host authority, never inferred from arbitrary process command lines or parent-child guesses.
Do not add a private endpoint or core patch merely to satisfy monitoring metrics.
Keep existing soak endpoint/status observation; resume per-plugin RSS/CPU/PID-churn work only after a native host-derived PID surface exists.

retirement_condition: Re-evaluate this blocker when the pinned N.E.K.O version exposes host-derived plugin PID/exitcode through an existing supported native read surface or another already-admitted component becomes the process-identity authority.
